planSteps.description: Navigate to the homepage and verify the hero section loads with the main headline and CTA button.
Verify the heading 'Made by Nature, Chosen by You' is visible, along with the 'Experience The Story' call to action.
Click on the 'FAQ' link in the top floating navigation bar.
Verify that the page scrolls to the FAQ section with the title 'Frequently Answered Curiosities'.
